name: Get job details
List jobs for the runner
description: List jobs for the runner Returns a paginated list of jobs for the runner, optionally filtered by status. GET /jobs
context:
GET /jobs
Returns a paginated list of jobs for the runner, optionally filtered by status.
Optional: page (query) — Page number of the results; limit (query) — Maximum number of jobs to return (default: 100, max: 500); status (query) — Filter jobs by status; offset (query) — Number of jobs to skip for pagination (default: 0)

name: Long poll for jobs
description: Long poll for jobs Long poll endpoint for runners to fetch pending jobs. GET /jobs/poll
context:
GET /jobs/poll
Long poll endpoint for runners to fetch pending jobs. Returns immediately if jobs are available, otherwise waits up to timeout seconds.
Optional: timeout (query) — Timeout in seconds for long polling (default: 30, max: 60); limit (query) — Maximum number of jobs to return (default: 10, max: 100)

name: Update job status
context:
POST /jobs/{jobId}/status
Update job status
Required: jobId (path) — ID of the job; body (body)
